description:
Get a specific attachment for a contact from Holded.

Args:
  - contact_id (string): The contact ID (required)
  - filename (string): The attachment filename (required)
  - response_format ('json' | 'markdown'): Output format (default: 'json')

Returns:
  Attachment file data (binary format, base64 encoded or URL).

response_format.description: Output format: 'json' for structured data or 'markdown' for human-readable

name: holded_invoicing_get_contact_attachment
title: Get Holded Contact Attachment
